name: Protopasta High Density Steel HTPLA @base
filament_notes:
High Density Steel HTPLA: 70% 400-series stainless steel by weight. No TDS is published. Proto-Pasta's launch article (Endless Exploration EX10) printed it at 200C at up to 24 mm3/s with a 0.4 mm steel nozzle. The 55C plate and the 'avoid below 3 mm3/s' advice are borrowed from their other metal-composite rows. Density 2.4 g/cm3 is a rough estimate and probably low for 70% steel - verify by weighing a known length.
Hardened nozzle recommended. Heat treat at 100C for 10+ minutes for heat resistance up to about 150C; expect some shrinkage.
